episodes.title: Welcome to Life House
episodes.summary: Jane is struggling, depressed, trapped, and torn, but she has an escape plan and it's fooling almost everyone.

episodes.title: A Handful of Oblivion
episodes.summary: Jane prepares for her flight home, with a plan to end her life mid-flight. But a chance encounter could lead to a break-through.

episodes.title: Please Remain Seated
episodes.summary: The plane has boarded. Jane is ready to say goodbye, but she has no idea what fate has in store for the flight.

episodes.title: Sweet Dreams and Flying Machines
episodes.summary: Jane awakens to find herself amongst the wreckage. And in the eye of the storm. The search for warmth and shelter begins.

episodes.title: You Can Die Here Alone
episodes.summary: Survivor's remorse settles in for Jane, but Paul pleads for her to stay strong and find the will to let them work together.

episodes.title: Don't Look Down
episodes.summary: Jane and Paul move into the wild. With nobody coming for their rescue, they find the courage to start a dangerous descent.

episodes.title: I Can't Hear You
episodes.summary: Jane reveals her previous plan to Paul. A truth that brings them closer together, just as their surroundings suddenly come crashing down.

episodes.title: The Weight
episodes.summary: Jane and Paul share their secrets, their memories, their pasts. And their feelings for each other.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.summary: Roles reverse as Paul lets his fears overwhelm his spirit. Jane steps up with courage and compassion.

episodes.title: What Does This Say About Us?
episodes.summary: A bad fall leaves Paul injured. As they struggle to move forward, his condition gets worse, leaving Jane to find help on her own.

episodes.title: A Hundred Echoes
episodes.summary: Jane leaves Paul to set out and find help on her own. Unaware and unprotected from the predators that lay ahead.

episodes.title: Where Memories Live
episodes.summary: Jane awakens in the hospital with a new feeling of hope, and the will to live the life she deserves.
